name: Blow-up of $\mathbb{P}^3$ in a genus 1 curve of degree 4
contractions: There is a divisorial contraction that contracts the exceptional divisor to the complete intersection of two quadrics in $\mathbb{P}^3$ and a contraction which is a quadratic fibration over $\mathbb{P}^1$

name: Blow-up of $\mathbb{P}^3$ in a genus 2 curve of degree 5
contractions: There is a divisorial contraction that contracts the exceptional locus to a genus 2 curve of degree 5 in $\mathbb{P}^3$ and another which contracts it to a line in the complete intersection of two quadric hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{P}^5$

name: Blow-up of $\mathbb{P}^3$ in $(2,3)$ complete intersection (genus 4 curve)
contractions: There is a divisorial contraction that contracts the exceptional divisor to the intersection of a quadric and a conic in $\mathbb{P}^3$ and another which contracts the exceptional divisor to the singular point of a singular cubic in $\mathbb{P}^4$

name: Complete Flag Manifold in $\mathbb{C}^3$, $\,\,\mathrm{Fl}(1,2,3)$
contractions: The two contractions are to Gr(1,3)$\cong\mathbb{P}^2$ and Gr(2,3)$\cong(\mathbb{P}^2)^{\vee}$. Both contractions have $\mathbb{P}^1$ fibers

name: $\mathbb{P}^1 \times \mathbb{P}^2$
contractions: There is one contraction to $\mathbb{P}^1$ with $\mathbb{P}^2$fibers and a contraction to $\mathbb{P}^2$ with $\mathbb{P}^1$ fibers
